_about: The Library's books. Each guide's text is the Discord posts in data/src/kb/<file>, split by <<<POST>>> lines. Tags after bold or italic text mark it on the site and are stripped from the Discord copy: {a} a quest you pick up (gold !), {t} a quest you hand in (gold ?), {q} a quest mentioned, {n} friendly NPC, {h} hostile (skull), {i} item. unsure: things nobody has confirmed on Forever; at lists the steps they belong to as part.step (parts count from 0). 'at' is when the book went on the shelf (it gets a ! until you've seen it). altParts: quest parts where you do one or the other (counted once in XP). A chain's optional quests still grey out with it but don't count toward its XP.

noMap._why: They stand inside Blackrock Mountain; the zone maps would only show its edge, under another zone's name.

Velarok Windblade._note: Not in NorgannonDB. This is the spot NorgannonDB gives Kalaran Windblade, who starts Divine Retribution there; the guide's coordinates match it.

guides.title: Ultimate BRD Quest Guide
guides.blurb: The Alliance BRD quests in two runs, with one trip back to Ironforge in between.
unsure: BRD wasn't in the Forever beta, so this leans on Forever's quest data and Blizzard's hotfixes more than on anyone's run.

unsure.text: Nobody has confirmed the Frenzied Black Drake still turns up at Cyrus. If it doesn't, do the Searing Gorge chain.
The Spectral Chalice needed Mining 230 in Classic. Forever's quest page doesn't say.
Attunement to the Core is in Forever's quest data, but Molten Core isn't open yet. If Lothos doesn't offer it, it isn't switched on.

chains.name: The Love Potion
chains.note: Very skippable. It needs mats from Azshara and Un'Goro and a second trip, and most groups don't bother.

chains.name: The Spectral Chalice
chains.note: Miners only (skill 230). It teaches Smelt Dark Iron.

chains.name: Attunement to the Core
chains.note: Molten Core isn't open yet. Grab it now so you're attuned when it is.

chains.name: The Challenge
items: Top Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
chains.note: Only if you're already on the Dungeon Set 2 chain from Dire Maul West. If you haven't done The Instigator's Enchantment, leave it for now.

tips.text: Right-click the note in your bags to start its quest.
Hearth or run out. Either works.
You need all 12 Relic Coffer Keys, so keep every key the dwarves drop.

before: Do the Onyxia attunement chain up to Marshal Windsor first. It starts with Helendis Riverhorn at Morgan's Vigil.

The long way to Cyrus's molt is the **Divine Retribution**{q} chain in Searing Gorge, nine quests from level 40. It starts with **Velarok Windblade**{n} (39.1, 39.0) and ends at the **Hoard of the Black Dragonflight**, a chest right beside him. Along the way he asks for 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil, then 8 Thorium Plated Daggers, then a Symbol of Ragnaros.
Miners need skill 230 for The Spectral Chalice.
The Challenge needs level 58 and the Dire Maul West chain. Skip it unless you're already on that chain.
Quests of level 48 and up also pay gold in Forever.
